description: Queries the M-26-14 data retirement audit index (m_26_14-retirement-requests) using ES|QL. Use this tool to find indices pending retirement, legal hold status, gate approval states, and audit trail for deletion decisions. Useful for POA&M drafting to surface open retirement compliance gaps. IMPORTANT supersession semantics: this index is append-capable - approvals and cancellations may be written as new records rather than updates, so a record with a pending_* state is not necessarily current. Before reporting an index as pending, check whether a later record for the same index_name has a superseding state (approved_gate1/approved_gate2/cancelled/deletion_completed).

configuration.query: FROM m_26_14-retirement-requests | WHERE state LIKE ?state | KEEP @timestamp, index_name, state, phase_age_days, created_at, updated_at, gate1_approved_by, gate2_approved_by, held_by, notes | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT ?limit

state.description: Retirement state to filter on (LIKE pattern, * wildcards allowed). Valid values: pending_gate1, approved_gate1, pending_gate2, approved_gate2, scheduled_for_deletion, legal_hold_initiated. Use * for all states, pending_* for both pending gates. Age is returned as phase_age_days for staleness filtering.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 20. Use 100 for full audit sweep.
